about.heading: Who We Are
about.description: Habl Allah Quranic Academy is a pioneering educational institution dedicated to spreading the sciences of the Noble Quran and teaching its recitation and Tajweed rules to the highest standards of quality. We believe Quranic education is a right for everyone, and we strive to make it accessible through modern technology.
